## Data Collection

We used the Palmer Penguins dataset, which contains measurements and species information for penguins observed in the Palmer Archipelago, Antarctica. The dataset was obtained from the publicly available GitHub repository maintained by the Palmer Penguins project (Horst et al., 2020).

We focused on three variables: penguin species, flipper length, and body mass. Species was used as the response variable, while flipper length and body mass were evaluated separately as predictors.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

# Create data directories
raw_dir = Path("../data/raw")
processed_dir = Path("../data/processed")

raw_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
processed_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Download the original dataset
url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/allisonhorst/palmerpenguins/main/inst/extdata/penguins.csv"
raw_data = pd.read_csv(url)

# Save the original dataset
raw_data.to_csv(raw_dir / "penguins.csv", index=False)

# Select relevant variables and remove missing values
data = raw_data[
    ["species", "flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g"]
].dropna()

# Save processed data
data.to_csv(processed_dir / "penguins_cleaned.csv", index=False)
```
